title: Korean Ground Beef Bowl
summary: A quick, flavourful weeknight dinner ready in 25 minutes. The sesame oil and ginger create an authentic Korean flavour profile.

steps.text: Ensure rice is cooked and ready (80-100g raw rice yields 240g cooked).
Place large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef, break apart with spatula. Brown until no longer pink (5-7 minutes). Drain excess fat if preferred.
Stir in minced garlic and ginger. Cook 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in soy sauce, sesame oil, and green onions. Stir well, simmer 2-3 minutes to meld flavours.
Divide rice into bowls (80g each). Spoon beef mixture over rice. Add optional vegetables or fried egg. Garnish with sesame seeds or extra green onions.

tips: For vegetables, my favourite in this dish are carrots and bell peppers, both cut into matchsticks (julienne). Toss into skillet with beef for last 2 minutes if you prefer them soft, or pile raw on top for crunch. For tangy Korean flavour, quick-pickle vegetables in rice vinegar, sugar, and salt for 10 minutes or use picked vegetables.
